what: The same, the module holding one network per block.
outcome: refused at install on every rank: the Python process payload pickled differently per process (PythonProcessContractError)
diagnosis: a model named by path was imported from a bare file, so its function pickled by value, and the class the module now defines carried cloudpickle's per-process tracker id, which hashed differently on every rank.  load_process_model imports a path-named module by name from its directory, so the function pickles by reference.
